note: Read the three stills at full size and frames 0, 12, 24, 49, 55, 61, 73, 74, 80, 86 and 98 of the 99-frame recording (49 arc, 25 circle to star, 25 formula). Circle to star: rounded halfway at 0.5 s, filled and closed with no twist, and a crisp five-point star at the last frame. Formula: A's three blocks are partway into B's shapes at 0.5 s, the bar and tall block overlapping as they pass, and the last frame is exactly B's triangle, pentagon and bar with nothing of A left.
